## EA Media Tools 2.6.4 - jaguar

### Critical Windows update fix

- Application-directory cleanup no longer runs while Squirrel is staging or installing an update. This prevents the running version from racing the updater or deleting the newly staged version.
- Cleanup now selects only versions older than the running application. The current version and any newer staged version are always preserved.
- On the first normal start after an update, the window and splash renderer load before cleanup begins. The splash reports cleanup progress instead of leaving the app invisible.
- Old directories are removed sequentially with short bounded retries. A directory that remains locked is logged and retried on a later launch without blocking the rest of startup.

### Changes carried forward from 2.6.3

- HEVC Main10 is independently configurable for capable encoders, including CUDA-native `p010le` conversion for NVIDIA SDR sources.
- Streaming and Cellular expose preset-driven 23.976 fps overrides and tier-specific multipass controls.

Version 2.6.3 was withdrawn from the public update channel and replaced by this release.

[Review changes since v2.6.2](https://github.com/eaforlife/media-converter/compare/v2.6.2...v2.6.4).
